mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based recovery in private demand, which strengthens corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative or insignificant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 118.0 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP growth and residential construction starts signals a strong expansion in private demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative or insignificant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% while payroll growth remains above 150k signals labor market tightness, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a positive or insignificant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain high interest rates, which increases discount rates on equity cash flows and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
